premises.text: 92% of commerce still takes place offline at physical retail stores
premises.evidence_span: But let's not forget that 92% of commerce still takes place offline at physical retail stores.

premises.text: Brands spend 25% of their budget on marketing and advertising without control over in-store execution
premises.evidence_span: Brands, they spend 25% of their budget on marketing and advertising and yet they have no control over what's really happening in stores.

premises.text: Poor in-store execution results in significant revenue loss
premises.evidence_span: this year, in Europe only, poor in-store execution will result in 20 billion euros of lost revenue.

premises.text: Collaboration between brands and retailers is currently inefficient
premises.evidence_span: the collaboration is broken. Brands and retailers are still relying on multiple phone calls and emails and very expensive and inefficient store visits.

premises.text: In-store execution requires a new collaboration platform
premises.evidence_span: we believe that in-store execution requires a new collaboration platform.

premises.text: Ubik allows brands to monitor operations globally and retailers to improve execution remotely
premises.evidence_span: Brands monitor their operation globally, retailers improve their execution remotely.

premises.text: Real-time data and insights improve in-store execution
premises.evidence_span: By combining sales data with merchandising info, she has now insights that were never available before.

premises.text: Ubik increases sales for customers by an average of 25%
premises.evidence_span: We increased sales for our customers by an average of 25%.

premises.text: Ubik has a SaaS business model charging on a per-user, per-company basis
premises.evidence_span: We have a SaaS business model where we charge on a pair-user, pair-company basis.

value.text: Retailers and brands can collaborate effectively to improve in-store execution and sales
value.evidence_span: we are Ubik, the collaboration platform for retailers.
